# Workflow contracts

`test.yml` runs provider-free checks and a fresh PostgreSQL migration proof. The database service is job-scoped and explicitly named `ink_admin_ci`; the workflow applies immutable Admin migrations through `pnpm db:migrate`, checks the journal, and proves a repeat run is a no-op. Google, Device browser interaction, real models and normal-database rollout remain separate acceptance stages with deployment credentials.

Do not add `drizzle-kit push`, generic schema synchronization, production DSNs, fixed user identities, or automatic real-Provider calls here.
